name: Sulfonic acids, C13-17-sec-alkane, sodium salts
description: Sulfonic acids, C13-17-sec-alkane, sodium salts is an anionic surfactant derived from secondary alkane sulfonation, delivering strong surface activity across a broad range of industrial formulations. It functions primarily as a cleaning, degreasing, and emulsifying agent. This chemical, identified by CAS 85711-69-9 , is utilized in both household and industrial product lines. In home care and industrial cleaning formulations, it provides effective grease removal and foam control in hard surface cleaners. It is a key component in degreasers and laundry detergents due to its robust performance. Textile and leather processors use it as a wetting and scouring agent to ensure uniform dye penetration and soil removal during wet processing. In the production of coatings and adhesives, it acts as an emulsifier and dispersant. These properties help to stabilize pigment suspensions and improve substrate wetting across various industrial applications and manufacturing environments. Paper manufacturing incorporates it into process chemistry where consistent fiber wetting and deinking performance are required. This surfactant is typically supplied as a liquid or paste to facilitate easy integration into liquid formulations. The active matter content commonly ranges around 30–60% depending on the specific grade required. Both technical and industrial grades are available to meet the performance requirements of cleaning product manufacturers and formulators. Drum and IBC packaging are standard supply formats for bulk procurement in the chemical industry. This ensures safe handling and efficient logistics for large-scale industrial users and chemical distributors worldwide.
